questions.answer: Most multifamily operators rely on a handful of dominant platforms: **Yardi Voyager** – The market leader for mid-size to large portfolios (thousands of units and up). questions.question: What property management accounting software do most multifamily operators use?
questions.name: ChatGPT (from memory)
questions.answer: **Yardi is the strongest single answer, especially for larger U.S. multifamily operators.** RealPage is another major platform. The clearest industry survey I found was NMHC’s 2022 technology benchmarking report: - **Accounting/general ledger:** 26 respondents named Yardi, compared with 5 for RealPage. - **Property management:** 29 named Yardi and 21 named RealPage; Entrata and MRI had 2 each.
